prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
ai_overview_text:
Here are some of the best online courses and platforms for learning shadow work and spiritual practice, broken down by approach and style:
Format: 4-class on-demand video and audio course ($127)
Focus: Deep exploration of Jungian shadow formation, projection in relationships, and turning unconscious patterns into psychological maturity. Jung Platform +1
Format: Online certification training
Focus: Comprehensive training on modern shadow work theory, cognitive dissonance, internal family systems, and how to integrate shadow work into a coaching or healing practice. Courses For Success
Format: 7-week deep-dive course
Focus: Combines Tibetan Buddhist traditions, lucid dreaming, shamanic practices, and Western psychology to befriend and transform the shadow. www.awakeacademy.org +1
Format: Self-paced digital courses and multi-week programs ($49–$134)
Focus: Bridging emotional healing, mindfulness, and spiritual awakening. Sounds True +1
Format: 10-day audio course (10 minutes per day)
Focus: Gentle, accessible introduction using somatic body awareness, inner child healing, and daily integration rituals. Insight Timer
Format: On-demand video course (2 hours total with downloadable prompts and meditations)
Focus: Practical exercises covering triggers, heart chakra self-care, anger, and shadow self-communication for beginners. Udemy
Format: Free 12-week self-paced course
Focus: Structured guided self-inquiry, journaling, and mindfulness to process unresolved traumas and release limiting beliefs.
Format: Free 5-hour video course/playlist (15 videos)
Focus: Jungian integration, somatic therapy, stopping projection, and releasing repressed emotions. YouTube·Jordan Thornton - Inner Work
Are you looking for a free self-paced course, a structured certification, or something focused more heavily on meditation and eastern philosophy?
